skill.displayName: 标讯 · 广东招标中标与招投标数据查询

llm.summary: This is a coherent Guangdong procurement-data skill that calls vendor APIs and has a disclosed, consent-gated account setup flow, though users should review the local API-key storage and device-feature registration behavior.

dimensions.detail: Network API use and optional web-search enrichment fit the skill purpose; auto-registration collects platform, CPU architecture, and a MAC hash only after user consent, but this is still host-derived data sent to the vendor.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package consists of Markdown instructions and references only; no executable scripts, package installs, remote payload execution, or tool wrapping were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most instructions are task-scoped, but the artifacts contain documentation inconsistencies around default region and money units, plus automatic company-scope expansion that could broaden analysis unless results are clearly labeled.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill reads an API key from the environment or ~/.zlbx/config.json and may write a returned API key there after consent; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but the docs do not specify secure file permissions, encryption, or easy deletion/revocation steps.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The advertised purpose, tool list, REST endpoints, company/search/market/account functions, and Guangdong default scope all align with procurement and tender-data lookup.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, know that the skill may call zhiliaobiaoxun.com APIs, use or create a vendor API key, collect limited device features for free-trial registration after consent, and store the API key in ~/.zlbx/config.json. Configure your own ZLBX_API_KEY if you want to avoid the automatic registration flow, and be careful with contact data and paid-account keys.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-only documentation is consistent with a Guangdong/China tender-data skill and is not evidence of unsafe behavior by itself.
[SSD-3] expected: Device-feature collection and API-key persistence are real, but the artifacts gate automatic registration on user consent and describe the collected fields; residual risk is local plaintext credential storage.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The reported region and amount-unit contradictions are valid documentation-quality risks that could produce wrong queries, but they do not indicate hidden or malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Company expansion and contact lookup are procurement-intelligence features; the contact docs include masking, no bulk export, and no web completion of masked numbers, while company expansion should be disclosed in responses.
[SDI-2] expected: Transmitting platform, architecture, and MAC hash to the registration endpoint is expected for the stated free-trial deduplication flow and is consent-gated, though users should understand it creates a device-linked account relationship.
[SDI-1] expected: Account creation, recharge links, and credential storage expand the onboarding surface, but they are documented in the skill rather than hidden and are tied to API access for the service.
[E1] expected: External transmission occurs to the vendor registration/API endpoints and is part of the declared service integration, not an unrelated exfiltration path.
[RA2] expected: Cross-session reuse of the vendor API key is intentional and disclosed; the main concern is lack of stronger storage and revocation guidance, not rogue persistence.
